description: This source file defines the InterfaceEngine class which implements the GenericEngine interface. It provides methods related to executing services, but all service execution methods throw exceptions indicating that interface services cannot be invoked directly, serving as a placeholder or a specialized implementation within the OFBiz framework's service engine.

classes.name: InterfaceEngine
classes.description: A class implementing the GenericEngine interface, primarily serving as a placeholder that throws exceptions for service invocation attempts.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Attempts to execute a service synchronously but always throws a GenericServiceException indicating that interface services cannot be invoked.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Attempts to execute a service synchronously without caring about the result but always throws an exception.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Attempts to execute a service asynchronously with a requester, but always throws an exception.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Overloaded method to run a service asynchronously without a requester, always throws an exception.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Methods to send callbacks, implemented as no-ops.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Overloaded method to send callbacks with result, implemented as no-ops.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Overloaded method to send callbacks with an exception, implemented as no-ops.
